rdfs:label: Dataset
rdfs:comment: A DCAT Dataset — a collection of data, published or curated by a single agent and available in one or more representations.
notes: DCAT's central class for data publication. Represents the abstract dataset; concrete files/APIs serving its content are `urn:solid:Distribution`s. Pair with `urn:solid:title`, `urn:solid:description`, `urn:solid:publisher`, `urn:solid:keyword` (dcat:keyword), `urn:solid:theme`; link Distributions via `dcat:distribution`. Schema.org's `schema:Dataset` is the SEO-flavored equivalent.

history.note: Notes now recommend urn:solid:keyword (dcat:keyword) instead of schema:keywords, and registry terms for title/description/publisher/theme.
